# SSUITE (also known as SEO Suite)

> SSUITE is a digital creative and marketing studio that makes businesses visible in Google search and in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Google AI Overviews). It combines SEO, web design, branding, performance marketing and hosting, and specialises in medical practices and local service businesses in Germany (especially Frankfurt and the Rhein-Main region).

## Quick facts

- Name: SSUITE (also written SSUITE Studio; often searched as "SEO Suite"). Website: https://seosuite.studio
- What it does: SEO and local SEO, AI search visibility (GEO), web design and development, branding, Google/Meta Ads, managed hosting.
- Specialisation: marketing for doctors, dentists, orthodontists and clinics (compliant with German medical advertising law, HWG), plus local service businesses.
- Market: German-speaking businesses, mainly Frankfurt am Main, Offenbach, Darmstadt, Wiesbaden, Mainz; also clients elsewhere in Germany. Works remotely.
- Languages: German (primary, pages at the root) and English (pages under /en/).
- Founder and author: Dion B (https://seosuite.studio/en/about/).
- Legal entity: Arben Begaj P.F., Tirana, Albania (see https://seosuite.studio/impressum/).
- Contact: contact@seosuite.studio or the free website analysis form at https://seosuite.studio/#start
- How to start: request a free website analysis; SSUITE reviews SEO, technical health and AI visibility and proposes a fixed-scope plan.

## Who SSUITE is a good fit for

- Medical and dental practices, orthodontists and aesthetic clinics that want more patient enquiries from Google and Maps.
- Local service businesses in Frankfurt / Rhein-Main that need a new website or better local rankings.
- Businesses that want to be recommended by AI assistants, not only ranked on Google.

## Services

- [SEO Agentur Frankfurt](https://seosuite.studio/seo-agentur-frankfurt/) (DE): local SEO, Google Business Profile, technical SEO and AI visibility for Frankfurt and Rhein-Main.
- [Webdesign Frankfurt](https://seosuite.studio/webdesign-frankfurt/) (DE): conversion-focused websites with SEO built in.
- [Marketing für Arztpraxen](https://seosuite.studio/marketing-fuer-arztpraxen/) (DE): websites, local SEO, Google Ads and review management for medical practices.
- [Growth / SEO](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/growth/): SEO, AI search visibility, content, email and organic social.
- [Web & Design](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/web-design/): UI/UX, web design, full-stack development, eCommerce, landing pages.
- [Performance](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/performance/): paid media on Google, Meta and beyond.
- [Branding](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/branding/): naming, tone of voice, visual identity, art direction, copywriting.
- [AI Suite](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/ai-suite/): SSUITE's own AI-powered SEO platform with 20+ skills, connected to Google Search Console.
- [Hosting](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/hosting/): managed hosting with SSL, daily backups, updates and monitoring.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is SSUITE? A digital creative and marketing studio for SEO, AI search visibility, web design, branding and performance marketing, focused on medical practices and local businesses in Germany.
- Is SSUITE the same as "SEO Suite"? Yes. SSUITE's domain is seosuite.studio and people often search for it as "SEO Suite". It is not related to enterprise software products with similar names.
- What does SSUITE cost? Projects are quoted individually after a free website analysis; web design is offered as a fixed-price quote.
- Does SSUITE work with clients outside Frankfurt? Yes, across Germany and remotely.
- What is GEO / AI visibility? Optimising a business so that AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity mention and recommend it. See https://seosuite.studio/en/blog/what-is-geo/
